scenario: [LUNI.16.2]'s `units.customary`, compiled as it ships: the standard library is on every fixture's search path and there is no `libraries` copy ([RCTS.1.2.14]), so this fails if the shipped `stdlib/units/customary.ds` stops compiling or stops declaring the dry measure the clause names. `bushel` is a slot type and a literal, so the vector also fails if it is moved out. `units.customary` imports from `units.si`, so that import is compiled too.
rules_ds:
from units.customary import bushel

schema Bin scope logical:
    id: String key
    grain: bushel mutable

rule full:
    Bin b where b.grain >= 100_bushel
->
    log info "full"
